descriptions.run_manifests: What an ingest set out to fetch, written before its first request: one row per roaster.
descriptions.job_manifests: The control plane: one row when a job starts and one when it ends, per connector and week.

run_manifests.name: run_date
run_manifests.description: The weekly run (the Monday of its ISO week).

run_manifests.name: started_at
run_manifests.description: When it was written, before the first request.

run_manifests.name: status
run_manifests.description: The roaster's registry status at that moment.

run_manifests.name: adapter
run_manifests.description: The adapter that will fetch it.

run_manifests.name: mode
run_manifests.description: full, sample, only or retry_failed; only a full manifest is the run's expected set.

job_manifests.name: run_date
job_manifests.description: The weekly run (the Monday of its ISO week).

job_manifests.name: job
job_manifests.description: crawl, crawl-retry, merge or enrich.

job_manifests.name: connector
job_manifests.description: The connector (adapter) the job served, if any.

job_manifests.name: shard
job_manifests.description: The shard, if the job was sharded.

job_manifests.name: attempt_id
job_manifests.description: One execution of the job; its start and end rows share it.

job_manifests.name: started_at
job_manifests.description: When the attempt started.

job_manifests.name: ended_at
job_manifests.description: When it ended (null on the start row).

job_manifests.name: status
job_manifests.description: running (start row), done, deadline or failed. An attempt with only a running row died.

job_manifests.name: todo
job_manifests.description: Roasters it set out to fetch.

job_manifests.name: ok
job_manifests.description: Roasters fetched.

job_manifests.name: errors
job_manifests.description: Roasters that failed.

job_manifests.name: parked
job_manifests.description: Stores parked mid-catalog for crawl-retry.

job_manifests.name: skipped
job_manifests.description: Roasters not started before the deadline.

job_manifests.name: requests
job_manifests.description: HTTP requests made.

job_manifests.name: http_429
job_manifests.description: 429 responses.

job_manifests.name: http_430
job_manifests.description: 430 responses (Shopify's IP-wide block).

job_manifests.name: egress_ips
job_manifests.description: The egress IPs the job's requests left from.

job_manifests.name: refusals
job_manifests.type: list<item: struct<ip: string, stores: int32, refused: int32>>
job_manifests.description: Per egress IP: stores contacted, and those that refused their first catalog request.

job_manifests.name: code_version
job_manifests.description: The code that ran.

job_manifests.name: detail
job_manifests.description: JSON: the job's own summary (arm, egress, rps, slice and salt for the confirmation run).

quality.rule: a job writes a running row at its start and one end row (done, deadline or failed)
run_manifests.mode is full, sample, only, retry_failed or null
